units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: I said I could bring everyone together. I should have specified a doorway.
units.caption_text: I said I could bring everyone together. I should have specified a doorway.

units.speaker: Bunny Easter
units.text: You did. The same one.
units.caption_text: You did. The same one.

units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
units.text: Three loads. Three openings. Use the cues.
units.caption_text: Three loads. Three openings. Use the cues.

units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: Each cue shows the load, its route and any blocked lane before we move. Nobody goes until we choose. I can take a breath without missing dinner.
units.caption_text: Each cue shows the load, its route and any blocked lane before we move. Nobody goes until we choose. I can take a breath without missing dinner.

units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: Eight places for eight actual commitments. I’ve never seen a blank board look so much like Frankie.
units.caption_text: Eight places for eight actual commitments. I’ve never seen a blank board look so much like Frankie.

units.speaker: Milo Pennant
units.text: Front door, living room, rear arch. Everyone to their courtyard places, then I sit down.
units.caption_text: Front door, living room, rear arch. Everyone to their courtyard places, then I sit down.

units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: No little speech in the doorway.
units.caption_text: No little speech in the doorway.

units.speaker: Milo Pennant
units.text: May I say “this way”? I’ve got to let some of it out.
units.caption_text: May I say “this way”? I’ve got to let some of it out.

laugh_opportunity.runtime_policy: Existing separately authorized speech/laugh presentation policy; never alter puzzle state. Suppress on quiet repeats, boundaries, apparent injury or sincere follow-up.

units.speaker: Bunny Easter
units.text: The lidded pot goes through the hatch, straight to the buffet. I’ll help you pass it.
units.caption_text: The lidded pot goes through the hatch, straight to the buffet. I’ll help you pass it.

units.speaker: Felix Bunt
units.text: Folded display, on the cart, through the side gate. Proper peg in. Rita says when.
units.caption_text: Folded display, on the cart, through the side gate. Proper peg in. Rita says when.

units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
units.text: I’ll bring the board through the house once the guest queue clears. Then we can call the toast.
units.caption_text: I’ll bring the board through the house once the guest queue clears. Then we can call the toast.

units.speaker: Bunny Easter
units.text: Straight through. Frankie’s cleared the buffet and opened the bowls. There’s supper.
units.caption_text: Straight through. Frankie’s cleared the buffet and opened the bowls. There’s supper.

units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: SERVE complete. Eight tasting bowls. Mine’s one of them. Bunny can stop counting my spoonfuls.
units.caption_text: SERVE complete. Eight tasting bowls. Mine’s one of them. Bunny can stop counting my spoonfuls.

units.speaker: Bunny Easter
units.text: The guest queue is in the way. The hatch puts us straight over the buffet. Back to the kitchen.
units.caption_text: The guest queue is in the way. The hatch puts us straight over the buffet. Back to the kitchen.

units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: People use the house door and rear arch. Dinner goes through the hatch. If we confuse those, I’ll have to garnish Milo.
units.caption_text: People use the house door and rear arch. Dinner goes through the hatch. If we confuse those, I’ll have to garnish Milo.

laugh_opportunity.runtime_policy: Existing separately authorized speech/laugh presentation policy; never alter puzzle state. Suppress on quiet repeats, boundaries, apparent injury or sincere follow-up.

units.speaker: Felix Bunt
units.text: Even folded, the display is wider than the hatch. Use the side gate. We’re not serving Rita’s work in slices.
units.caption_text: Even folded, the display is wider than the hatch. Use the side gate. We’re not serving Rita’s work in slices.

units.speaker: Rita Stringer
units.text: Dinner first. Hungry people look at ceramic bowls for the wrong reason.
units.caption_text: Dinner first. Hungry people look at ceramic bowls for the wrong reason.

units.speaker: Rita Stringer
units.text: Yes. Bring it through the side gate. Once it’s in place, open the screen. I’d like to tell them about it myself.
units.caption_text: Yes. Bring it through the side gate. Once it’s in place, open the screen. I’d like to tell them about it myself.

units.speaker: Felix Bunt
units.text: Gate held. Folded width clear. Bringing it through.
units.caption_text: Gate held. Folded width clear. Bringing it through.

units.speaker: Vivian Voss
units.text: Into the marked footprint. Keep it concealed behind the screen.
units.caption_text: Into the marked footprint. Keep it concealed behind the screen.

units.speaker: Felix Bunt
units.text: Thank you for noticing the gate. Even if I had to say it myself.
units.caption_text: Thank you for noticing the gate. Even if I had to say it myself.

laugh_opportunity.runtime_policy: Existing separately authorized speech/laugh presentation policy; never alter puzzle state. Suppress on quiet repeats, boundaries, apparent injury or sincere follow-up.

units.speaker: Vivian Voss
units.text: Wait until the display is in its marked place. At present, we’d be unveiling the wall.
units.caption_text: Wait until the display is in its marked place. At present, we’d be unveiling the wall.

units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: Opening the viewing side. Rita, it’s yours.
units.caption_text: Opening the viewing side. Rita, it’s yours.

units.speaker: Rita Stringer
units.text: I made this for the house. Three doors, one table. I tried separate tables. It looked lonely.
units.caption_text: I made this for the house. Three doors, one table. I tried separate tables. It looked lonely.

units.speaker: Bunny Easter
units.text: You put us in it.
units.caption_text: You put us in it.

units.speaker: Rita Stringer
units.text: I put room for you in it. You can decide where to sit.
units.caption_text: I put room for you in it. You can decide where to sit.

units.speaker: Mr. Stringer
units.text: You made all that?
units.caption_text: You made all that?

units.speaker: Rita Stringer
units.text: Yes. You’ve been eating off my other work for years. I wanted one you couldn’t put gravy on.
units.caption_text: Yes. You’ve been eating off my other work for years. I wanted one you couldn’t put gravy on.

laugh_opportunity.runtime_policy: Existing separately authorized speech/laugh presentation policy; never alter puzzle state. Suppress on quiet repeats, boundaries, apparent injury or sincere follow-up.

units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: SHOW complete. Rita’s panel, presented by Rita. I didn’t have to explain a single thing on her behalf.
units.caption_text: SHOW complete. Rita’s panel, presented by Rita. I didn’t have to explain a single thing on her behalf.

units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
units.text: I’ll take the board through the house. The route’s clear now.
units.caption_text: I’ll take the board through the house. The route’s clear now.

units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
units.text: Milo must get everyone seated first. Then I can carry the board through the house. It’s wide enough without a guest on each end.
units.caption_text: Milo must get everyone seated first. Then I can carry the board through the house. It’s wide enough without a guest on each end.

units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: Everyone, a moment. We’ve fed you and shown you Rita’s work. Now let’s say what we’re actually agreeing to.
units.caption_text: Everyone, a moment. We’ve fed you and shown you Rita’s work. Now let’s say what we’re actually agreeing to.

units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: TOAST. Everybody here, board ready. No one has to promise anything they didn’t agree to.
units.caption_text: TOAST. Everybody here, board ready. No one has to promise anything they didn’t agree to.

units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
units.text: Food first, then Rita’s presentation. The promises will keep until we’ve kept those two.
units.caption_text: Food first, then Rita’s presentation. The promises will keep until we’ve kept those two.

units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: That’s in use. If I move it now, somebody will spend the rest of supper holding their bowl and being polite about it.
units.caption_text: That’s in use. If I move it now, somebody will spend the rest of supper holding their bowl and being polite about it.

units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
units.text: {blocked_place_name} is blocked. Put the furniture back on its plan mark before we send this load.
units.caption_text: {blocked_place_name} is blocked. Put the furniture back on its plan mark before we send this load.

dynamic_bindings.blocked_place_name: The already-failed route or landing-place condition named by the existing overlay.

units.speaker: Mr. Stringer
units.text: Supper has been served, Rita has presented her work, and the board is here. Who gets the ceremonial flourish?
units.caption_text: Supper has been served, Rita has presented her work, and the board is here. Who gets the ceremonial flourish?

units.speaker: Jackie Tree
units.text: A brief household-led toast, or your limited introduction. The actual commitments stay as agreed.
units.caption_text: A brief household-led toast, or your limited introduction. The actual commitments stay as agreed.

units.speaker: Mr. Stringer
units.text: Yes. Just the form of the toast. Practice first, or begin?
units.caption_text: Yes. Just the form of the toast. Practice first, or begin?

units.speaker: Mr. Stringer
units.text: A rematch, on the same narrow terms. We can practice first.
units.caption_text: A rematch, on the same narrow terms. We can practice first.
